reference: PLAN: 1. Find information about Profile Lake and its location relative to Cannon Mountain. 2. Identify the height of Cannon Mountain based on the found information.

corruptions.text: PLAN: First, identify the individuals who were students of Rolls Gracie and trained under Romero "Jacare" Cavalcanti. Next, determine which of these individuals ran the Gracie Humaitá school in Rio de Janeiro.

descendants.hop_1: FINDING: The individual who ran the Gracie Humaitá school in Rio de Janeiro was Helio Pinto Cavalcanti, a student of Rolls Gracie and trained under Romero "Jacare" Cavalcanti.
